Name: Maaseiah, Son of Adaiah
Summary: Maaseiah, son of Adaiah, was one of the captains of hundreds Jehoiada took into covenant to crown Joash.
KeyStory: Jehoiada took Maaseiah the son of Adaiah into covenant with him.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, the Priest; Adaiah, Father of Maaseiah
LifeLesson: A covenant kept in secret became a coronation in public.
